description: List parliamentary codes, identifier formats, historical committees and political groups, or coverage limitations. Choose organizations with organization_ids to resolve supported membership organization IDs into published names and dates; ordered per-item found false means no detail was published. Organization lookups page the supplied IDs with an effective maximum of 20 per call; repeat the same ID list with page.next_offset. Other topics retain historical coverage and an effective maximum of 100. These lists do not require snapshots; missing end dates do not establish current status.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20, effective maximum 20 for organizations or 100 for other topics, with notice.

organization_ids.description: Required nonempty list only for organizations; order and duplicates retained, with at most 20 looked up per page.

items.description: Decimal organization ID, org/ prefix, or exact https://data.europarl.europa.eu/org/ URI.

topic.description: Reference topic; organizations requires organization_ids, which other topics reject.

name: euparl_list_reference

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mode_fields`: organizations lacks organization_ids or another topic supplies them. `invalid_filter`: A nonblank language or organization identifier is unsupported. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Whole reference entries on this page.
Reference entry; organization identities are not inferred query codes.

code.description: Published identifier or supported query token.

description.description: Accepted spelling, source family or coverage explanation.

end_date.description: Published organization interval end date; absence does not establish current status.

found.description: Organization lookup result; false only for HTTP 204 or 404.

id.description: Published corporate-body identity, including org/ prefix.

language.description: Actual language of the published text.

name.description: Published full organization name from prefLabel in its actual selected language.

language.description: Actual language of the published text.

organization_id.description: Normalized decimal organization identifier on lookup results.

source_url.description: Public organization identity URL on lookup results.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size, at most 100.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

totalCount.description: Exact count only when published or computed over a complete collection.

truncated.description: True when this page returns only part of the selected collection.
